description: This file defines a Java interface for reading loan schedule history data, including methods to fetch current version numbers, retrieve repayment archive schedules, and fetch old audit dates. It is part of the loan account scheduling subsystem in the Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanScheduleHistoryReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for fetching loan schedule history data, including current version, repayment archive schedules, and audit dates.

methods.name: fetchCurrentVersionNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the current version number for a specified loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentArchiveSchedule
methods.description: Retrieves the repayment archive schedule for a specified loan, given related loan data, disbursement data, and schedule type.

methods.name: fetchOldAuditDates
methods.description: Fetches audit date information for a given schedule ID.
